title.en: An Act Appropriating the Sum of Five Million Pesos to Enable the National Housing Commission to Resume Its Functions.

text.en:
In order to enable the National Housing Commission created by Commonwealth Act Numbered
Six hundred and forty-eight to accomplish its purposes and objects as set forth in the said Act, there is
appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated the sum of five million
pesos: Provided, however, That said sum shall not be released for expenditure by the said Commission except
upon order of the President of the Philippines who, in his discretion, may require that release of the said
amount be in full or in installments; And provided further, That the funds herein appropriated shall not be
released unless and until the Secretary of Finance and the Auditor General shall have certified to the President
that there are existing and available funds in the National Treasury in excess of the sums appropriated in the
General Appropriation Law for the fiscal year ending June 30, 1946, and the priority appropriations
established by law.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, November 1, 1945.
